title: The Robots Are Stumbling on Their Way to the Revolution - CNET
summary: Single-task robots like robot vacuums and pool cleaners have become exceptionally efficient, but a humanoid must merge physical dexterity with contextual intelligence. Hello Robot’s Stretch 4 is another humanoid take, and the most restrained.
